attributes.board_name: Alabama State Board of Occupational Therapy

rules.accepted_credit_types: At most 1/3 of credits may be administration/management/academic; the rest must relate to direct patient treatment. At most 1/3 of hours from the therapist's own professional presentations.
rules.audit_note: Proof of CE must accompany the renewal application; the Board's renewal instructions direct licensees to post CE certificates in CE Broker.
rules.notes: Rule wording: 1.5 CEUs (15 contact hours) annually or 3.0 CEUs (30 contact hours) biennially; 1 CEU = 10 contact hours. Current licenses expire 10/31/2026. A renewal counts as timely only if the application, fee and proof of CE are submitted at least 60 days before expiration; otherwise a late fee applies.
rules.rule_quote: (1) An Occupational Therapist must obtain 1.5 CEUs (or 15 contact hours) annually or 3.0 CEUs (or 30 contact hours) biennially.

rules.accepted_credit_types: At most 1/3 of credits may be administration/management/academic; the rest must relate to direct patient treatment. At most 1/3 of hours from the licensee's own professional presentations.
rules.audit_note: Proof of CE must accompany the renewal application; the Board's renewal instructions direct licensees to post CE certificates in CE Broker.
rules.notes: Rule wording: 1.0 CEU (10 contact hours) annually or 2.0 CEUs (20 contact hours) biennially; 1 CEU = 10 contact hours. Current licenses expire 10/31/2026. A renewal counts as timely only if submitted with proof of CE at least 60 days before expiration.
rules.rule_quote: (2) An Occupational Therapy Assistant must obtain 1.0 CEU (or 10 contact hours) annually or 2.0 CEUs (or 20 contact hours) biennially.
